en.headline: 227 own commits across 12 repos, four skill releases and issue reports upstream
en.teaser: Most of the window went into OpenCode skill tooling: sandbox knowledge notes, a JSON output contract for skill management, and a 3.0 rewrite of the model picker.
en.overview:
The window was dominated by OpenCode skill tooling. `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` carried the largest share of work, mostly knowledge-base documentation: VS Code harness notes on extensions, keybindings and BYOK boundaries, SenseNova image-skill quick references with two flagged guesses, and corrections to the Windows-without-WSL2 claim. AGENTS.md was tightened with branch discipline and push-proxy notes, and the knowledge-ingest command stopped pushing to main unconditionally. One pull request was opened in that repository.

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` moved to a structured output contract: all four actions now return a single JSON object with a declared output schema, and the English and Chinese documentation pages were synced to it. A concurrency fix serialized disable/enable writes so parallel calls cannot overwrite each other. Releases v1.1.0 and v1.2.0 shipped, the latter fixing a false divergence warning in list, normalizing frontmatter booleans, and no longer turning a failed sidecar write into an error.

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` was rewritten around priced accounting and Console calibration. Version 2.0.0 added quota math and Console MCP state detection; 3.0.0 cut the readable surface from seven Markdown files to two and from nine runtime scripts to one entry point; 3.0.1 enforced a candidate model menu, per-source chains and a comparing gate in check. Calibration no longer restamps an old bias with today's date.

`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` gained automatic text wrapping with CJK-aware breaking, proportional font-size fallback with a 9px floor, a bilingual CLI, and a 40-image command gallery. Fixes covered Korean falling back to the Galmuri font, right-side decoration width, and pure query commands working without Pillow. Releases v0.2.0 and v0.3.0 shipped.

Elsewhere, `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` handled provider probing deduplication and added Xiaohongshu Dots as a daily-report fallback, alongside 581 automated commits. `sogeisetsu/dsh-openchamber-plugins` ported OpenChamber features into DSH plugins and skills, and `sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` got mobile viewport fixes at 375 and 414 pixels plus a single-button theme switcher. Upstream, issue actions went to openchamber, anomalyco/opencode, microsoft/PowerToys and deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness discussions.

highlights.text: v1.1.0 made all four actions return one JSON object with a declared output schema instead of Markdown.
3.0.0 reduced the skill from seven Markdown files and nine runtime scripts to two files and one entry point.
v0.3.0 added automatic line wrapping, overflow protection with a 9px font floor, and a full CLI manual.
Opened a pull request in the sandbox repository during the documentation push.
Reported that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime; it was later closed.
Reported a NullReferenceException in Shortcut Guide hold-Win activation when the runner process cannot be inspected.
Commented on the feature request about running the CLI shipped with the Windows desktop build.

byRepo.text: 83 own commits and no automated commits, plus 1 pull request and 0 issue actions. AGENTS.md gained branch discipline and push-proxy notes, knowledge-ingest stopped pushing to main unconditionally, and an Iceman pelican eval was added with a failure analysis.

40 own commits and no automated commits, with 2 releases and 0 issue actions. The four actions were changed to emit a single JSON object with a declared output schema, and both the English and Chinese site pages were synced to that contract. A fix serialized disable/enable writes to stop concurrent overwrites. v1.1.0 and v1.2.0 shipped, the latter fixing the false divergence warning, normalizing frontmatter booleans and keeping a successful config change successful when the sidecar write fails.

29 own commits and no automated commits, with 2 releases and 0 issue actions. Added automatic text wrapping with per-character CJK breaking and space-based Latin breaking, proportional font-size fallback down to 9px, a bilingual CLI, and a 40-image command gallery. Fixes covered Korean using the Galmuri font, width reservation for right-side decoration, and pure query commands working without Pillow. v0.2.0 and v0.3.0 shipped.

20 own commits and no automated commits, with 3 releases and 0 issue actions. 2.0.0 introduced priced accounting and Console MCP state detection; 3.0.0 collapsed the skill to one entry point and one reference; 3.0.1 enforced a candidate model menu, per-source chains and a comparing gate in check. Calibration was fixed so an old bias is never restamped with today's date, and the output docs now state which money source each basis may print.

21 own commits plus 581 automated commits, with 0 pull requests and 0 issue actions. Provider probing was deduplicated by including headers in the key and wrapping probe in a catch, reducing duplicate requests. Xiaohongshu Dots was added as the tail fallback for the daily report chain, MODELS.md was split out of AGENTS.md, and .gitignore rules for .history and daily sketches were corrected.

19 own commits and no automated commits, with 0 pull requests and 0 issue actions. OpenChamber features were ported into DSH plugins and skills, including a hidden-files toggle, an /init project instructions skill and a zh-doc-sync skill. Ported skills were archived, delivered assets marked, a handoff-review shuttle planned, and a Chinese README plus local AGENTS translation added.

11 own commits and no automated commits, with 0 pull requests and 0 issue actions. Mobile layout was fixed for real 375 and 414 pixel viewports, covering two-row navigation, KPI wrapping, table wrapping and touch targets. The theme switcher became a single button with a popup menu and an SVG favicon, orphan CSS was removed, three plugins were merged into the resource list, and a GitHub repository button plus LICENSE were added.

Also commented on the storage management request for seeing and clearing task temp files.

zh.headline: 本人提交 227 次，覆盖 12 个仓库，发布 4 个技能版本并向上游报 issue
zh.teaser: 本期主要投入 OpenCode 技能工具链：沙箱知识库补记、技能管理的 JSON 输出契约，以及模型选择器的 3.0 重写。
zh.overview:
本期工作集中在 OpenCode 技能工具链。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 承担了最大份额，几乎全是知识库文档：VS Code harness 的扩展、快捷键与 BYOK 边界笔记，SenseNova 图像技能速查（其中两处推测已标注），以及“Windows 不必上 WSL2”的实测纠正。AGENTS.md 补入分支纪律与推送代理说明，knowledge-ingest 不再无条件推 main，该仓库还开了一个 pull request。

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 转向结构化输出：四个动作统一返回单个 JSON 对象并声明 output schema，中英文文档站同步更新。并发修复让 disable/enable 串行化，避免并发写互相覆盖。v1.1.0 与 v1.2.0 相继发布，后者修正了 list 的误报分歧、统一了 frontmatter 布尔值解析，并让 sidecar 写入失败不再把已成功的配置变更报成错误。

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 围绕计价核算与 Console 校准重写。2.0.0 加入配额计算与 Console MCP 状态探测；3.0.0 把可读内容从 7 个 Markdown 文件压到 2 个、运行脚本从 9 个收敛到 1 个入口；3.0.1 强制候选模型菜单、按来源决定链长，并让 check 重新推导数字。校准不再用当天日期给旧偏差重新打戳。

`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 新增自动折行（CJK 逐字断行、拉丁按空格断行）、按比例降字号并以 9px 为下限的溢出保护、双语命令行和 40 张命令示例画廊。修复包括韩语改用 Galmuri 字体、右侧装饰预留宽度、缺少 Pillow 时纯查询命令仍可用。v0.2.0 与 v0.3.0 已发布。

其余仓库中，`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 对探测去重并接入小红书 Dots 作为日报链尾兜底，另有 581 次自动提交；`sogeisetsu/dsh-openchamber-plugins` 把 OpenChamber 功能移植为 DSH 插件与技能；`sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` 修复 375 与 414 真实视口适配并改为单按钮主题切换。上游方面，issue 互动分布在 openchamber、anomalyco/opencode、microsoft/PowerToys 以及 deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness 的讨论区。

highlights.text: v1.1.0 让四个动作统一返回单个 JSON 对象并声明 output schema，不再输出 Markdown。
3.0.0 把技能从 7 个 Markdown 文件、9 个运行脚本压缩到 2 个文件和 1 个入口。
v0.3.0 加入自动折行、以 9px 为下限的溢出保护，并补齐完整命令行手册。
在文档集中更新期间于沙箱仓库开了一个 pull request。
报告设置中的 MCP 页面漏掉了 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器，该 issue 随后被关闭。
报告 Shortcut Guide 按住 Win 激活时，若无法检查 runner 进程就抛 NullReferenceException 且不显示任何内容。
就 Windows 桌面版自带 CLI 却无法运行的功能请求发表了评论。
